binding.corrected_pmcd: fit CT=a+b*xi+c*h_corr(xi) by least squares on exactly three probes
binding.probe_rule: nearest distinct row to each quantile target, without replacement
binding.pure_j_pmcd: fit CT=a+b*J+c*h_pure(J) by least squares on exactly three probes

claim_boundary: A pass supports a Reynolds-like correction to advance ratio selected by projective/few-probe transfer and a reusable projective dynamic CT mechanism on unseen UIUC propeller geometries. It does not establish discovery of J from raw sensors, exact Reynolds-number physics, broad domain generality, state-of-the-art aerodynamics, or general AI scientific discovery.

coordinate.interpretation: R is a Reynolds-like RPM*D^2 proxy, not a claim of exact blade Reynolds number.
coordinate.name: reynolds_corrected_advance_proxy

development.coordinate_selection_note: gamma=-0.10 is a rounded consensus in the stable development plateau; no holdout contents were available.
development.selection: all eligible non-holdout families from V014_SPLIT_PROTOCOL

evaluation.collapse_metric: For each run pair sorted by RPM, evaluate the lower-RPM CT curve against linear interpolation of the higher-RPM curve on overlapping candidate-coordinate support; RMSE divided by pooled CT range floored at 0.01; family score is the median pair score.
evaluation.common_support: for every model, score confirmatory rows whose J lies within the calibration run observed J range
evaluation.family_nrmse: concatenate all scored confirmatory points in a family; RMSE divided by max(CT)-min(CT); invalid if range <0.01
evaluation.projective_alignment: post-hoc diagnostic only: fit full-run cubic in corrected xi, normalize nonlinear coefficient vector [x^2,x^3], take absolute dot with frozen h; family score median across runs.

holdout.manifest_canonicalization: JSON object {families:[...]} sorted keys, compact separators; each family has family, diameter_in, pitch_in, calibration_run{path,blob_sha,rpm}, confirmatory_runs same; trailing newline.
holdout.metadata_selection: reconstruct exactly from immutable source tree using V014_SPLIT_PROTOCOL rules: matching standard family, deduplicate equal filename RPM by minimum rank_hash=sha256(path+NUL+blob_sha), sort by RPM, calibration=lower median, others confirmatory.

mechanism.learning: per run cubic CT(x); remove affine coefficients; projectively normalize [x^2,x^3]; sign-align within family; average per family and unit-normalize; leading SVD direction across all 139 development families.
